description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_VarParser, which provides functionality for parsing and validating string representations of PHP variable types into their native types. It includes constants for various types, lookup tables for types and string types, and methods for parsing variables according to their types with validation and error handling.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_VarParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing string representations into native PHP variable types and validating them.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Validates and transforms a variable into its specified type, with optional null allowance.

methods.name: parseImplementation
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to be overridden by subclasses for actual parsing logic.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Throws an exception with a given message.

methods.name: errorInconsistent
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating an inconsistency in implementation.

methods.name: errorGeneric
methods.description: Throws a generic type mismatch exception.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string name of a given type constant.
